rationale: Remove the cabin-heating cost inherited from passenger-car assumptions. The default two-wheeler energy and mass model contains no corresponding cabin heat pump.

evidence.finding: No cabin HVAC arguments are passed to the shared energy calculation and no heat-pump equipment is added in the mass model. set_costs sums the shared purchase components.
heat pump cost is included in purchase but not markup, so its static EUR 300 value enters purchase once, without markup.

method: Set all seven scoped defaults to deterministic zero (amount and loc zero, uncertainty_type 1, remove obsolete nonzero bounds). Keep the parameter and shared cost equation so caller-supplied values are preserved.
qualifications: This is a correction of model equipment scope, not a market-price calibration or a universal claim about every real electric two-wheeler.
A custom heat-pump cost is a monetary scenario input only; it does not introduce heating physics, equipment mass or an inventory exchange.
Battery thermal-management assumptions and charger costs are not changed.
Earlier glider priors are not refitted; their previous residual calibration deliberately excluded the heat-pump charge.
Previous cost audit files and provenance remain historical; their hashes and reference prices identify the defaults they describe.
